packageRules.description: The review-tracking copies -- .github/workflows/prune-reviews.yml, tools/ci-prune-reviews.sh and tools/review-tracking.sh -- must stay byte-identical to shakenfist/development's templates/review-tracking/, because a review mark attests to a blob SHA and one changed byte makes the copy a file nobody has reviewed. Only the workflow holds anything Renovate manages today, and bumping it here put the copy ahead of the template and failed the review-tracking-templates audit (#263); the two scripts are listed so the rule still covers them if the template ever gives them a pin. Its pins move in the template, which development's own Renovate updates, and reach this copy by re-syncing from the template. That includes security fixes: enabled: false suppresses vulnerability alerts too.
